name: muse
description: Offload bulk coding work to Muse Code instances in isolated git worktrees, each supervised by an Opus agent that reads the patch, runs the acceptance check and re-prompts until the work is right.

default_effort.title: Default reasoning effort
default_effort.description: Effort every delegated round starts at: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh or max. Teams differ on whether low is right for their codebase. Raise it and every task costs more; lower it and more tasks come back needing a revision round.

max_rounds.title: Maximum revision rounds per task
max_rounds.description: The runaway-cost breaker. A supervisor gets this many rounds to get a task right before the script refuses rather than letting it loop up a bill.

worktree_root.title: Where worktrees are created
worktree_root.description: Leave empty to create them beside the repository, which is the default and keeps them outside it. Set a path if your setup forbids writing next to a checkout. A path INSIDE the repository removes the isolation that makes --yolo defensible. A path containing a single quote is not supported and is refused.

refuse_on_secrets.title: Refuse to delegate a tree containing a credential
refuse_on_secrets.description: On by default, and worth keeping: contributor-tier models state that content may be used for product improvement, and sending a private key there is not undoable. Turn it off only for a repository whose credential-shaped content is entirely test fixtures.

default_model.title: Model for delegated work
default_model.description: latest-contributor resolves the newest contributor-tier model from muse's own catalog at run time, so a new generation is used the day it lands. Pin a full-rate id such as muse-spark-1.3 for proprietary or client-confidential code.
